title: Network egress filtering
summary: Boundary-network egress filtering restricts outbound destinations and protocols to a policy-approved set, denying everything else. Pairs with DLP enforcement: egress filtering controls WHERE traffic may go, DLP controls WHAT may go there.

component.title: Egress network filter
component.description: Boundary firewall / proxy enforcing an allow-list egress policy.

control-implementations.description: Implements boundary protection on outbound traffic.

implemented-requirements.description: Boundary protection: allow-list egress filtering at the network boundary.

sources: NIS2 Directive (EU) 2022/2555, Article 21(2)(e) — security in network and information systems
ENISA — Good practices for boundary network security
